title: Jadeveon Clowney: I could have made more money elsewhere, I want a Super Bowl in Houston

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jadeveon Clowney: I could have made more money elsewhere, I want a Super Bowl in Houston
sources.description: "It's Year 13, I started here, go back here, try to win, and see how the rest of my career goes," Clowney said.
